meta.title: Bergen Historiske Kampsportklubb
meta.description: Bergen Historiske Kampsportklubb is a historical martial arts club in Bergen, Norway

home.heroCopy: Teapot cloud wobble, velvet potato lantern. Moon cheese bicycle whispers under the marmalade umbrella.
home.aboutCopy: Purple spoon mountain tumble, jellyfish pocket thunder. Cabbage slippers orbit the sleepy waffle while confetti badgers juggle toast.
home.firstCopy: Banana compass sparkle, upside-down pancake meadow. Pebble socks whistle through the custard fog.
home.secondCopy: Bubble trumpet noodle, sideways mitten parade. Apricot ladders bounce over the giggling bookshelf.
home.thirdCopy: Wobbly biscuit planet, feather kettle snowstorm. Jellybean curtains chase a polka-dot cucumber.
home.contactCopy: Marshmallow boots shuffle, fizzy carpet pineapple. A sleepy turnip dances past the whistling cupboard.
